description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives. 

 Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.
   
 WORK SCHEDULE 
 This is a full-time, exempt (salaried) position assigned to a First Shift schedule, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.  Regular collaboration with teams in India and the United States is required.  The role may occasionally support production releases or critical incidents outside standard local business hours.
  
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
·   AEM Development: Design, develop, configure, and maintain AEM components, templates, Sling Models, OSGi services, workflows, schedulers, servlets, content fragments, experience fragments, and authoring capabilities.
 ·   Reusable Platform Capabilities: Create modular, configurable solutions using AEM Core Components and established design-system patterns to increase reuse across business areas and reduce one-off development. Customize and extend the AEM platform using Java, HTL/Sightly, and other relevant technologies to meet specific project needs.
 ·   Business & Stakeholder Partnership: Partner closely with US-based product, marketing, content, analytics, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, provide technical consultation, clarify feasibility, define implementation approaches, and ensure successful delivery of website capabilities and enhancements.
·   Integration Delivery: Build and support integrations between AEM and APIs, DAM, analytics, personalization, CRM, search, identity, consent, and other enterprise services.
 ·   Quality Engineering: Write unit and integration tests, participate in peer code reviews, remediate defects, and follow secure coding, accessibility, performance, and coding standards.
 ·   Performance & Reliability: Optimize website performance and ensure efficient content delivery through caching, indexing, page rendering and other AEM optimization techniques. Support monitoring and root-cause analysis.
 ·   Release Support: Contribute to estimates, sprint commitments, deployment plans, release validation, rollback readiness, and post-production verification during approved deployment windows.
 ·   Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve issues across author, publish, Dispatcher, application, and integration layers in partnership with operations, QA, and IT teams. Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards, best practices, and security guidelines.
 ·   Documentation & Transition: Create and maintain technical specifications, runbooks, solution diagrams, test evidence, and knowledge articles; actively participate in agency knowledge transfer and reverse-shadow activities. Document technical specifications, system architecture, and deployment processes to facilitate knowledge sharing and future maintenance.
 ·   Agency & Partner Collaboration: Work closely with external agencies, implementation partners, and third-party vendors to review solutions, coordinate delivery activities, align development standards, resolve technical issues, and ensure the quality and consistency of platform implementations.
 ·   Agile Collaboration: Partner with product, UX/UI, content, front-end, API, QA, analytics, and platform teams throughout discovery, refinement, development, testing, and release.

 MIMIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 
 Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business administration, or a related field.
 Five or more years of software development experience including experience with AEM 6.x or AEM as a Cloud Service.
   
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 
 Five or more years of experience in digital, ecommerce, content, or brand marketing.
 Adobe Experience Manager certification.
  
 ADDITIONAL JOB STANDARDS 
 Experience with AEM as a Cloud Service, Cloud Manager, Adobe Target, Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics, and enterprise DAM integrations. Experience working with deployment pipelines, code quality gates, and release management processes.
 Experience with accessibility standards such as WCAG, secure development practices, SEO, performance optimization, and high-traffic websites.
 Hands-on experience with AEM Core Components, editable templates, content fragments, experience fragments, and authoring frameworks.
 Strong understanding of AEM architecture, author/publish topology, Dispatcher, caching, replication, permissions, workflows, and content packaging.
 Proficiency in Java, OSGi, Apache Sling, JCR, HTL/Sightly, Maven, and AEM component and service development.
 Experience with REST APIs, JSON, GraphQL and common enterprise integration patterns.
 Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, debugging, and Agile delivery.
 Experience in digital marketing, ecommerce marketing, or content marketing roles.
 Experience managing multi-channel marketing campaigns.
 Experience working in B2B, B2C, or B2B2C environments
 Knowledge of digital marketing, ecommerce, and content strategy.
 Ability to analyze performance data and apply data-driven insights.
 Strong written, verbal, and storytelling communication skills.
 Project management and organizational skills.
 Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
 Familiarity with digital marketing platforms, automation tools, and CRM systems.
 Ability to analyze complex issues and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical partners.
  
 Labcorp is a global life sciences and healthcare company harnessing science for human good. Every day, our mission is to improve health and improve lives.
  
 We are seeking an AEM Developer to design, build, test, and support reusable capabilities for Labcorp.com on Adobe Experience Manager. This role will be a core member of the internal website engineering team and will work across Labcorp.com to deliver secure, scalable, accessible, and high-performing digital experiences.
  
 Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. Employees who are regularly scheduled to work a 7 on 7 off schedule are eligible to receive all the foregoing benefits except PTO or FTO.
